sampling_frame.description: Python-primary open-source repositories that define or ship agent tools. This is the CANDIDATE universe, not the analyzed set. part_a/run.py screens each candidate for at least one write-capable tool definition; only candidates that pass screening enter the analyzed set and the headline denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Public GitHub repository, Python-primary source tree.
Ships agent/tool-calling machinery or is itself an autonomous agent.
Selected for recognisability in the LLM-agent ecosystem (frameworks, autonomous agents, coding agents, browser/computer-use agents).
exclusion_criteria: JavaScript/TypeScript-primary repositories: the detectors in run.py are Python AST/regex heuristics and would systematically under-detect on non-Python sources.
Repositories with no agent-tool surface at all (pure model libraries, datasets, prompt collections).
sampling_frame.known_limitations: This frame is a convenience sample of well-known projects, not a random sample of all agent repositories. It is biased toward large, well-maintained projects, which if anything biases the measured test-coverage rate UPWARD (i.e. the true untested rate across the long tail is likely higher, not lower).
